title: Android 10 alerts not working
body:
Since I updated my phone to Android 10 I'm unable to get audio alerts to highs and lows.

I've updated xDrip (currently in 5th Dec nightly), and made sure that the alert profile setting is to high volume, high priority, and all that.

I've also made sure that my media volume on the phone isn't silenced, but I still don't get alerts which is pretty crucial for dealing with a hypo in the middle of the night.

Just to be clear, alerts themselves do work - I get a notification of a low or predicated low, and my phone will vibrate. But it no longer speaks the alert like it did with Android 9.

Galaxy S10+

comments.body:
Just to add to this, here are the screen shots of how I have my alerts set up
![Screenshot_20191216-134743_xDrip+](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/42671801/70912092-207ccb80-200b-11ea-9b69-2a374d9e5b06.jpg)
![Screenshot_20191216-134958_xDrip+](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/42671801/70912093-21156200-200b-11ea-81a2-d7a01cb26c9c.jpg)

Nothing on these screens has changed sincei updated to Android 10.

I was in bed last night, funded into bed with a steady reading of 7.2mmol and within 30 minutes or so I was dropping like a log. I got no audible notification of either the rapid fall or the incoming hypo at all. I spent nearly an hour in a hypo state with nothing but I vibration to warn me.

Previously my phone would speak to me (e.g. "low predicted in 23 minutes") but it just isn't happening any more.

If it isn't a bug in xDrip, please hello me figure out what I need to change on my phone to get the old alerts back. If it is a bug with xDrip, can it be looked at as a priority?

I've slept through 2 hypos now, and nearly did a third last night.

Thanks

Another night and another slept through hypo. Woken by by girlfriend whose phone was vibrating and alerting in follower mode.

I appreciate this may well not be an xDrip bug, but if someone can help me in understanding what the issue is, and more importantly, fixing it, that would be incredibly helpful. I can't see anything in either the system settings or xDrip settings that would suggest alerts are suppressed or shouldn't be coming through. But I need this to start working like it used to.

Please help!

Can you please change alert tone to default xDrip and press test alert?

Also what profile are you on?

It works fine when I test it, but not in real life

What do you mean by what profile am I on?

Same problem here:
If I test the alert: everything is working, the phone is also vibrating, but i get no sound (independent what sound i choose)
The problem occurs since 3 days (after i updated my Xperia XZ2 Compact to Android 10). Befor the update to Android 10, everything works.

@mistermintsgh can you clarify is it just the spoken information which is not working? Is your phone on do not disturb when this happens? Do the vibrates still happen? Please also advise which xDrip version you are using. Thanks

@jamorham I don't know @mistermintsgh case, but in my case the alarm doesn't appear any more. I also have "override phone silent mode" acitivated. Phone is not on "do not disturb" mode, it still vibrates.
@charliebravoAT when you say `doesn't appear any more` do you mean there is no notification shown or just there is no sound?

@jamorham I'm on the Dec 31st nightly. The notification appears on the phone, but I had no sound, no speech and no vibration. Any setting for overriding do not disturb/silent mode was turned on (i.e. whatever the phones state is, sound all alarms for a low/predicted low)

I think I've found a work around for it though....

The notification wasn't sitting in the "silent notifications" part of the notification bar, but was obviously still being silent. I've long pressed the persistent xDrip notification, then made sure that the switch for Uncategorised notifications is on and that they are set to Alert (see screenshot)

For some reason, this radio button is set to silent, even if all the notification settings in the phone and the app are set to ignore silent/DND. It seems to have fixed the issue, but I'm baffled as to why the problem existed in the first place.

![Screenshot_20200109-115242_xDrip+](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/42671801/72065914-38c4cb00-32d7-11ea-919a-59347f9c3d03.jpg)
@charliebravoAT Does the workaround of @mistermintsgh also work for you?
